name: Default
shortDescription: cobalt processing API that saves media from social and video sites, ready to be used from the cobalt web app or any API client.

alerts.message: This deploys the processing API only, with no web interface. Point the cobalt web app at it under settings > instances > use a custom processing server, or call the API directly.
The instance is open to anyone who knows its URL. For a public deployment, protect it with API keys or Turnstile as described in the upstream guide.
